sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 179 was established by Ordinance No. 18362, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 15, 1984. Ordinance No. 18362 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 18362 was amended by Ordinance No. 19427, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 17, 1986, and Ordinance Nos. 24098 and 24099, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 10, 1999. Ordinance No. 24098 rezoned a 24.1536 acre portion of the Property from PD 179 to an R-5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18362; 19427; 24098; 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 179 is established on property generally located west of Calumet Boulevard, north of the north line of Jefferson Boulevard. The size of PD 179 is approximately 14.1336 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18362; 24098; 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-179.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan approved by the city plan commission on October 7, 1999, is labelled Exhibit 179A. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. A development plan must be approved by the city plan commission before issuance of any building permit. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.106.PERMITTED USES. The uses permitted in this district are those uses permitted in the I-1 district, subject to the same conditions applicable in the I-1 district, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the I-1 district only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this PD only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the I-1 district is subject to DIR in this PD; etc. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Building Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.107.MAXIMUM BUILDING HEIGHT. No structure on the Property may exceed 30 feet in height, except radio, television, or microwave tower uses and commercial radio or television transmitting station uses which may exceed 30 feet as provided in Section 51-4.408(a)(1). (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.108.MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE. Maximum permitted lot coverage for all buildings and structures combined on the Property, excluding the area that lies in the Escarpment Zone, is 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.109.MINIMUM SETBACKS. Minimum setbacks for the Property are those permitted in an I-1 district except as shown on the approved conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.110.LANDSCAPING. A landscape plan must be submitted with the development plan and approved by the city plan commission before issuance of a building permit. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.111.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the City of Dallas. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.112.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard City of Dallas specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.113.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the City of Dallas. (Ord. Nos. 24099; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-179.114.ZONING MAP. PD 179 is located on Zoning Map No. L-5. (Ord. Nos. 18362; 25508)
